name: E00_1_dazzling_angel_each_creature_entering_gains_one
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.' Support card: FDN Dragon Fodder (verified; 'Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.'). Seat 0's Angel is on the battlefield. Dragon Fodder puts two Goblin tokens onto the battlefield at once: each is another creature entering under seat 0's control, so the Angel triggers once for each, 20 + 1 + 1 = 22. Seat 1 gains nothing.
